description: This file defines the LLMComponent class responsible for initializing and configuring various language model (LLM) instances based on provided settings. It handles importing external dependencies, setting up tokenizers, and selecting specific LLM implementations such as LlamaCPP, Sagemaker, OpenAI, Ollama, AzureOpenAI, Gemini, and a mock version.

classes.name: LLMComponent
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for initializing and managing different LLM instances based on configuration settings.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the LLM instance based on the provided settings, handling different model types and dependencies.
